findings.highlight: Saber liked baths, she liked my cooking, liked the clothes Tohsaka brought her, and she had incoherent conversations with Fuji-nee.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは風呂が好きだったり、メシが旨いと満足そうだったり、遠坂が用意した服を気に入ったり、藤ねえとテンポの合わない会話をしてた。
findings.governingReading: Saber and Fuji-nee’s conversational tempos do not mesh.
findings.explanation: Conversations with mismatched timing become incoherent conversations.

findings.highlight: Things took a turn after that.
findings.evidenceJa: ……もう、その段階でどうかしてた。
findings.governingReading: He recognizes that he was already not himself at that stage.
findings.explanation: Already changed by that point becomes a change after it.

findings.highlight: I won't make any requests.
findings.evidenceJa: なら、後悔などしない。
findings.governingReading: After choosing not to speak, he resolves not to regret it.
findings.explanation: Not regretting the choice becomes making no requests.

findings.highlight: It's what spilled onto me ten years ago."
findings.evidenceJa: —十年前、おまえが我に浴びせたモノだ」
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh identifies it as what YOU poured/showered onto ME ten years earlier.
findings.explanation: The accusation that Saber showered him with the mud loses its actor.

findings.highlight: "That is what you have always sought.
findings.evidenceJa: 「それがおまえの求めた質問の答えだ。
findings.governingReading: Kirei identifies his explanation as the answer to the question Shirou asked.
findings.explanation: The answer to Shirou’s question becomes what Shirou has always desired.

findings.highlight: The kind of hell that causes souls to burst...allowing humans to shine their brightest. Do you not want to bear witness to such a glorious sight, Shirou Emiya?
findings.evidenceJa: あのような地獄にこそ魂の炸裂、ヒトにおける最高の煌めきがある。それはおまえ自身も体験した事ではないかな衛宮士郎。
findings.governingReading: Kirei asks whether Shirou himself has already experienced that hell and its human intensity.
findings.explanation: Past personal experience becomes a desire to witness the spectacle.

findings.highlight: What do you think? Do you not agree that the dying, agonized shrieks of humans wallowing in their regret fill your breast with the most indescribable pleasure?"
findings.evidenceJa: どうだ。無念のまま朽ちる人間の叫びは、胸に迫るものがあっただろう？」
findings.governingReading: The cries of people dying with unfulfilled regrets pressed upon/moved his heart; the question does not specify pleasure as the feeling.
findings.explanation: Being moved by dying cries becomes indescribable pleasure.

findings.highlight: The ground is on fire.
findings.evidenceJa: 地面を焼く音。
findings.governingReading: The narration reports the sound of the ground being burned, before identifying steaming mud.
findings.explanation: A sound of burning ground becomes ground visibly on fire.

findings.highlight: The dark mud spreading over the lake is steaming.
findings.evidenceJa: じゅうじゅうと湯気を立てているのは、池から伸びてきた黒い泥だった。
findings.governingReading: The steaming mud has reached out from the pool into his path on the ground.
findings.explanation: Mud extending from the pool becomes mud spreading over the lake.

findings.highlight: It follows no matter how far I retreat, and it's not the only one.
findings.evidenceJa: その気になれば何処まで退いても追ってくるだろうし、その数だって、一本だけという事もあるまい—
findings.governingReading: If it chose to, it would probably follow anywhere; he expects it will not be limited to one tendril.
findings.explanation: Conditional expectations about pursuit and number become observed facts.

findings.highlight: We needn't put this off any longer.'
findings.evidenceJa: これ以上先延ばしにする必要はない」
findings.governingReading: The speech begins with a double quotation mark and ends in this entry.
findings.explanation: A double-quoted speech closes with a single apostrophe.

findings.highlight: Saber twists away from a short sword fired at her and takes a step toward her enemy.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは振るわれた剣をくぐり抜け、一歩深く敵の間合いへと侵入する—！
findings.governingReading: Saber slips under the sword swung at her and moves deeper into his combat range.
findings.explanation: Dodging a swung melee sword becomes dodging a fired short sword.

findings.highlight: She needs to defeat Gilgamesh before he can use Ea, or she will lose.
findings.evidenceJa: ギルガメッシュがエアを取り出す前に斬り伏せなければ、倒されるのは自分の方だ。
findings.governingReading: Her stated condition here is defeating him before he takes Ea out.
findings.explanation: Defeating him before he draws Ea becomes defeating him before he uses it.

findings.highlight: "Take another strike from Ea? That is preposterous. Even with my sheath returned, I could not possibly survive that attack."
findings.evidenceJa: “—エアを受ける……？　まさか。いかに鞘が戻ろうと、アレを受けては立ち上がれない”
findings.governingReading: Saber thinks she could not get up after receiving it, even with the sheath returned.
findings.explanation: Being unable to rise after the attack becomes certain non-survival.

findings.highlight: This is the way knights should fight.
findings.evidenceJa: それが、この騎士の本来の戦い方である。
findings.governingReading: The previous deployed weapons illustrate this particular knight’s true/original method, contrasting his preceding swordplay.
findings.explanation: This knight’s original fighting style becomes how knights ought to fight.

findings.highlight: His many Noble Phantasms are deployed within time and space, and become bullets under their master's command.
findings.evidenceJa: この無数の宝具は、空間に“展開”され、主の命によって自らが弾丸となる。
findings.governingReading: The treasures deploy in space and become projectiles on their owner’s command.
findings.explanation: Spatial deployment receives an added temporal component.

findings.highlight: She evades every single one as if gracefully slipping between falling leaves.
findings.evidenceJa: 舞い散る木の葉のように、悉くを受け流す—！
findings.governingReading: She receives and redirects every attack, with a falling-leaf simile.
findings.explanation: Deflecting all the weapons becomes evading between them.

findings.highlight: A three-pronged sword sweeping at her in an arc.
findings.evidenceJa: 弧を描いて後方から奇襲する三枚刃、
findings.governingReading: It describes an arcing surprise attack coming from her rear.
findings.explanation: The curved three-bladed weapon loses its attack from behind.

findings.highlight: A hammer larger even than her streaks toward her like a meteor!
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女を上回るほど巨大な鉄槌の薙ぎ払い—！
findings.governingReading: The enormous hammer makes a sweeping blow.
findings.explanation: A giant hammer’s sweep becomes a meteor-like flight.

findings.highlight: A torrent of Noble Phantasms slams into the ground one after another.
findings.evidenceJa: 宝具の雨の中、次々と被弾していく。
findings.governingReading: The recipient of successive hits is Saber, whose damaged equipment and avoided fatal wounds immediately follow.
findings.explanation: Saber being repeatedly hit becomes weapons striking the ground.

findings.highlight: Her armor is shattered, her gauntlet is split open, and even her greaves are impaled.
findings.evidenceJa: 鎧は砕かれ、籠手を貫かれ、足下を守る衣服さえ串刺しになっていく。
findings.governingReading: Armor is broken, the gauntlet pierced, and even the clothing protecting her feet is skewered.
findings.explanation: Protective clothing around her feet becomes greaves.

findings.highlight: I can't feel my mud-coated right ankle, and I wasn't entirely sure I even still had my right leg until I used it to leap away.
findings.evidenceJa: 粘液が張り付いた右の足首は感覚がなく、カカトから先がくっついているかさえ判らなかったが、ともかく目前の空き地へ飛び込んだ。
findings.governingReading: Numb at the right ankle, he cannot tell whether the part forward of the heel is attached, but leaps anyway; the next page explicitly checks the ankle.
findings.explanation: Uncertainty about the foot becomes whole-leg loss supposedly resolved by jumping.

findings.highlight: The scent of burning earth wakes my dizzy head, and I push myself back up to my feet.
findings.evidenceJa: 地面を焼く匂いで目眩を起こす頭をしぼって、立ち上がって、それから—
findings.governingReading: He strains his head, made dizzy by the smell of burning ground, and gets up.
findings.explanation: The smell causing dizziness becomes the smell waking his head.

findings.highlight: There's not enough time for me to hold back about using Projection; it's my only hope.
findings.evidenceJa: ……頼みの綱の“投影”も、出し惜しみなんてしていない。
findings.governingReading: He expressly denies that he has been saving his last resort; the subsequent explanation establishes the opportunity/concentration barrier.
findings.explanation: Not holding Projection in reserve becomes no time to hold back about using it.

findings.highlight: A tidal wave of mud crashes over me.
findings.evidenceJa: 止まる事など許さない、と無数の泥が振り下ろされた。
findings.governingReading: Many masses of mud swing down, refusing to let him stop; he narrowly dodges in the next entry.
findings.explanation: Downward attacks become a wave crashing over him.

findings.highlight: "What a fool he was. He cursed himself and let me go, then died only a few years later.
findings.evidenceJa: 「道化と言えば道化だな。ヤツは自身を呪った私を見逃し、その果てに数年足らずで命を落とした。
findings.governingReading: Kotomine says Kiritsugu spared him despite his having cursed Kiritsugu. Shirou then infers responsibility: '切嗣が死んだのはコイツのせいで。' corresponds to 'Kiritsugu died because of Kotomine?'
findings.explanation: Kotomine's claim that he cursed Kiritsugu becomes a statement that Kiritsugu cursed himself. This weakens the direct basis for Shirou's ensuing accusation; it does not establish whether Kotomine's account is true.
